app.server_offline: Can't reach the local-eml server. Is it running?

library.title: Your library
library.body: Every message you've imported lives here. Click a subject to read it, or middle-click to open it in a new tab.

import.title: Import your mail
import.body: Drop .eml files, folders, .zip archives, .mbox files (Google Takeout) or Outlook .pst files here — or pull straight from an S3 bucket or IMAP mailbox. Duplicates are skipped automatically.

export.title: Export your library
export.body: Download everything as a single .zip, or upload to an S3 bucket. Re-running an export skips what's already there.

stats.title: Library stats
stats.body: See your archive in numbers: emails per year, top senders, total size, and more.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Switch the interface language, change date display, and manage saved IMAP and S3 profiles.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: Find messages by sender, subject, or body. Hangul initial consonants work too — type ㅎㄱ to find 한국. Matching characters are highlighted in the results.

starred.title: Star what matters
starred.body: Star messages from the list or the viewer, then use this filter to see only starred mail.

dates.title: Narrow by date
dates.body: Pick a start and end date to show only mail sent in that window. Both ends are included.

help.title: Need this again?
help.body: Press the question mark any time to replay this tour.

categories.title: Sort with categories
categories.body: Give mail a coloured label, then filter to it here. Create and rename categories under Settings → Categories; each email can carry one.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Browse without the mouse: j/k move through the list, Enter opens, / jumps to search, and ←/→ step between emails in the viewer. Press ? anytime for the full list.

library.table_caption: Email library. Select a subject to open the message.

viewer.flag_banner: Flagged as {flag}. Shown as plain text only — HTML, images, attachments and links are disabled. Unflag it under Settings → Spam & phishing.
viewer.sha_help: The SHA-256 fingerprint of this message's .eml file. It uniquely identifies the message and is the file's name on disk.
viewer.no_html: No HTML part in this message.

external_link.title: Leaving Local Eml
external_link.body: This link goes to an external site and will open in a new tab.

missing_file.title: Message file is missing
missing_file.body: This message is listed in the database, but its .eml file can't be found on disk. It may have been deleted or moved outside Local Eml.
missing_file.question: Remove this entry from the database?

not_indexed.title: Not in the database
not_indexed.body: This .eml file is on disk but has no database entry, so it won't appear in the library or in search results. Add it now?

import.drop: Drop .eml files, a directory, a .zip, an .mbox, or a .pst here
import.dedup_note: Duplicates are detected by SHA-256 and skipped.
import.s3_confirm_hint: Recursively imports every .eml object under the prefix.
import.imap_hint: Connects read-only; messages are never marked read on the server.
import.imap_confirm_hint: Imports every message in the selected folder.
import.imap_sync_label: Receive new mail in the background
import.imap_sync_help: Stores the password encrypted on this machine and incrementally fetches new messages every {interval}.
import.imap_sync_help_off: Stores the password encrypted on this machine. Automatic fetching is turned off — use the interval below to enable it.
import.sync_interval_error: Failed to save the check interval
import.imap_never_synced: Not synced yet — run an import once to start.
import.imap_sync_needs_password: Run an import once to seed the password
import.s3_creds_optional: Leave Access Key ID and Secret Access Key blank to use the credentials in ~/.aws/credentials or the AWS_* environment variables.

export.zip_hint: Every .eml in your library is packed into one zip and streamed to your browser.
export.s3_hint: Streams every .eml to the bucket. Objects already at the destination prefix are skipped.
export.s3_confirm_hint: Uploads all local emails to the bucket under the given prefix; existing keys are skipped.

settings.flagged_help: Messages flagged as spam or phishing are hidden from the library and, when opened, shown as plain text only: no HTML, no images, no attachments, no clickable links. Unflag a message to restore it.
settings.risk_warnings_help: Checks each message offline for structural signs of phishing — links whose text doesn't match their destination, links to raw IP addresses or lookalike domains, failed SPF/DKIM/DMARC, a Reply-To on another site, executable attachments, password forms. It's a warning, never a verdict; nothing is hidden automatically.
settings.resync_help: Re-scans the .eml files on disk and adds any that are missing from the database. Existing messages are skipped.
settings.update_confirm: Local Eml {from} will be replaced with {to}. The download is verified against the release's SHA-256 checksums first. The server restarts and this page reloads by itself once it's back.
settings.date_format_help: Choose how dates are shown in the email list. The detail view always uses the full date.
settings.week_start_help: Which day begins the week in the date range calendar.
settings.attributions_intro: Local Eml is built with these open-source projects.
settings.categories_help: Seven colour labels for organising mail, like Finder tags. Each email can carry one. Rename them here; leave a name blank to use the colour's own name.

stats.title: Library stats
stats.undated: {count} emails have no date and are not shown here.
stats.empty: No emails yet — import some to see your stats.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.prev_next: Previous / next email in the viewer

restore.title: Restore metadata from a backup
restore.hint: Upload an export .zip (or the local-eml.db inside it) to bring back stars, categories, settings and connection profiles. Import your .eml files first — the restore only applies metadata to emails already in the library, and never deletes anything.
restore.password_note: IMAP passwords cannot be restored: they are encrypted with a key that never leaves the original machine, so they are dropped from backups. Restored IMAP profiles come back with sync off — re-enter the password to re-enable it.
restore.confirm: Apply metadata from this backup? Stars, category assignments and settings in the backup overwrite current values.
restore.summary: {emails} emails updated · {categories} categories · {settings} settings · {profiles} profiles added

risk.title: This message has signs of phishing
risk.hint: Heuristic warning — check the sender and links before acting on it. Flag it to hide it and disable its links, or turn warnings off under Settings → Spam & phishing.
risk.link_mismatch: Link text names a different site than it goes to
risk.ip_link: Link goes to a bare IP address
risk.reply_to_mismatch: Replies would go to a different site
risk.sender_mismatch: Display name embeds an address on another site
